units.title: Hello!
units.mascotTip: Tat says: Let's say hello!

reading.passage: Hello! I am Sam. I am six years old. I like dogs.
reading.question: How old is Sam?
reading.explanation: Sam says I am six years old

units.title: Colours
units.mascotTip: Tot says: The world is colourful!

listening.ttsText: Look at the sky. It is blue.
listening.question: What colour is the sky?

reading.passage: I see a rainbow! It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
reading.question: How many colours?

units.title: Numbers 1-10
units.mascotTip: Tat says: Let's count!

reading.passage: I have five pencils and two erasers in my pencil case.
reading.question: How many pencils?

writing.instruction: I have _____ fingers on each hand.

units.title: My Body
units.mascotTip: Tot says: Touch your nose!

vocabulary.example: I wear a hat on my head.

listening.ttsText: I can see with these. I have two.
listening.question: What are they?

reading.passage: My face has two eyes, one nose and one mouth. My eyes are brown.
reading.question: What colour are the eyes?

units.title: My Family
units.mascotTip: Tat says: Who is in your family?

listening.ttsText: My mum makes breakfast every day.
listening.question: Who makes breakfast?

speaking.targetText: I love my mum and dad.

reading.passage: My family is small. There is Mum, Dad, my sister and me. We live in a flat.
reading.question: How many people?

units.title: Fruits
units.mascotTip: Tot says: Fruits are yummy and healthy!

vocabulary.meaning: a round red or green fruit
a small round fruit in bunches
a big green fruit, red inside
a small red fruit with seeds

listening.ttsText: This fruit is long and yellow. Monkeys like it.
listening.question: What is it?

reading.passage: At the fruit shop, I can see apples, oranges and bananas. Mum buys five apples and three oranges.
reading.question: How many apples?

units.title: Animals
units.mascotTip: Tat says: Woof! Meow! What animals do you know?

listening.ttsText: It has four legs and says woof. It is a pet.
listening.question: What is it?

reading.passage: I have two pets. One is a cat and one is a fish. My cat is white. My fish is orange.
reading.question: What colour is the cat?

writing.hint: Birds do this in the sky

units.title: Food
units.mascotTip: Tot says: What do you eat for lunch?

listening.ttsText: I drink this every morning. It is white and comes from cows.
listening.question: What is it?

reading.passage: For breakfast, I have bread and milk. For lunch, I have rice and chicken.
reading.question: What does the child eat for lunch?

units.title: Toys and Games
units.mascotTip: Tat says: What toys do you have?

vocabulary.example: We fly kites in the park.
I sleep with my teddy bear.

listening.ttsText: You can fly this in the park when it is windy.
listening.question: What is it?

reading.passage: In my toy box, I have a ball, a puzzle and two dolls. My favourite is the puzzle.
reading.question: What is the favourite toy?

units.title: Clothes
units.mascotTip: Tot says: What are you wearing today?

vocabulary.example: Wear a hat in the sun.

listening.ttsText: I wear these on my feet. I put them on before shoes.
listening.question: What are they?

speaking.targetText: I am wearing a blue shirt.

reading.passage: Today I wear my school uniform. I have a white shirt, grey trousers and black shoes.
reading.question: What colour are the shoes?

reading.question: How many school words are listed?
